description_en: Modifies the attributes of a cloud disk file or folder, such as the file name
description_zh: 修改网盘文件或文件夹的属性，例如文件名
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --end-user-id user01 --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-6432670000 --file-id 6333e553a133ce21e6f747cf948bb9ef95d70000 --file-name NewFileName.txt --conflict-policy ignore --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who uses the cloud disk
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html to query the ID of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The conflict resolution policy when a file with the same name exists
parameters.help_zh: 出现同名文件时的处理策略
parameters.name: conflict_policy
